changes: Bridge deck and graded approaches share the actual town paving material, texture scale and phase; a paved inn approach clears the entry garden
Exact terrain cuts under four town stairways remove coplanar surfaces without exposing triangular gaps; merged masonry faces are separated
Building cutaways require actual mesh occlusion inside the solid house and roof footprint; approaches, awnings and chimneys alone do not hide a building
Validated representative approach avoids the synchronous post-pump pathfinding search; steady water geometry stops uploading redundant vertex buffers
Directed action-based tutorial with 23 recorded world-narrator lessons, pulsing UI highlights, Open/Continue controls, replay, optional skip and projected interaction arrows
Persistent selected-enemy arrow, enemies and readable title/turn-order backplates at top left, party status at top right
Larger textured attack ribbons, impact rings, sparks, smoke, spell beams and pooled dynamic lighting
Depleted downstream channels progressively widen, rise and flow after gate repair; reservoir, cascade endpoints and reflection planes share the hydraulic state
Continuous non-pixel cloud density, opposite-side overhead key light, sky bounce, world-space rain puddles, wet surfaces and synchronized foliage/shadow wind gusts
Normal running at 6.6 m/s and Shift sprint at 8.25 m/s, retaining native 10/12 FPS eight-direction cycles
Overworld horizontal dimensions doubled to 2048 by 1152 metres, retaining physical building size, with 16464 trees, more meadow and geological dressing
M renders the actual playable overworld terrain, roads, bridges, river meshes and settlement models, with distance LOD, saved discovery fog and existing fast travel; legacy positions migrate

art.note: V17 reuses the approved-concept-derived selected art; clouds, terrain edges and world effects are rendered procedurally.

transcription.scope: 23 additional world-narrator tutorial lessons. Name spellings and draughts/drafts are equivalent in the recording. Original 259 recordings retain their V15.1 verification.
